description.value:
Almonk discovered this spell while studying the residue of destroyed magical conduits: the Weave itself ignites when its threads are forcibly redirected. You ignite the magical ether in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. The burning ether persists as long as you sustain the spell.

Whenever a creature within the area casts a spell or uses a magical ability that requires its own concentration or manipulate action, the ether scorches them. That creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Their spell or ability functions normally regardless of the save result — Almonk's Retribution punishes, it does not interrupt.

This spell is associated with the mage Almonk and is typically encountered as a focus spell for practitioners of anti-magic doctrine. Its conversion to a standard spell slot is noted as unusual.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes 6d6 fire damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 12d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage on failure increases by 1d6.
